title: Which court functions?
hook: The court moves. Did local jurisdiction move with it?

knows: Selected accounts can describe distinct institutions and dated changes.

claims.text: ICOMOS describes Delhi’s new capital and controlled court access. Husain’s 1937 guide describes Agra’s private audiences and council business through an uncollated Persian inscription and chronicles. Similar court functions do not establish identical municipal jurisdiction or one day when every institution moved. Capital location, access and local powers are separate questions.
